verdict.rationale: Clara documents per-card spend limits that reset monthly, weekly or daily, plus card configurations that add time, day-of-week and merchant-category restrictions (clara-docs-31, clara-docs-15, clara-docs-32). That gives real card-level enforcement, and marketing mentions automated approvals (clara-docs-21). However, nothing shows budgets being allocated to teams or projects and enforced. Labels only tag transactions with cost centers or project IDs after the fact (clara-docs-13), and the budget messaging is about AI insights rather than enforcement (clara-docs-23). Missing for 10: team/project budget objects, budget-to-card limit linkage, documented approval workflows that block over-budget spend, independent corroboration.
